title: [Dev] NSv3/v1 is spamming/duplicating entries in log
symptom: AAPS and AAPSClient on the same phone are spamming/duplicating entries in the log, seen with TBR and TT. This makes sync slower between client and AAPS. Also, when requesting the devicestatus collection of the API, almost every 5 minutes there are 2 entries a few seconds apart.
cause: The maintainer states that the status is generated on more places (not only after enact) for example for cases like open loop, failed enact etc. This is considered correct behavior.
fix: The maintainer added logging to show the reason for the duplicate status generation. No specific fix was provided; the issue was considered correct behavior.
evidence_quote: from my point of view it's correct. Status is generated on more places (not only after enact) for example for cases like open loop, failed enact etc. I added logging anyway so you can see the reason
